articles.t: GTA 6 : Rockstar pousse la relation de Jason et Lucia à l’extrême, mais il y a quelque chose qui cloche
articles.chapeau: La campagne marketing qui bat son plein, les installations qui font la promotion du jeu, les musiques qui constituent la bande-originale diffusées par-ci par-là… Pas de doute, l’arrivée de Grand Theft Auto 6 est imminente, et la publication d’une nouvelle bande-annonce cette semaine n’en est qu’une....
articles.txt:
La campagne marketing qui bat son plein, les installations qui font la promotion du jeu, les musiques qui constituent la bande-originale diffusées par-ci par-là… Pas de doute, l’arrivée de Grand Theft Auto 6 est imminente, et la publication d’une nouvelle bande-annonce cette semaine n’en est qu’une preuve supplémentaire. Et pour le coup, celle-ci a décidé de faire monter la température entre Jason et Lucia, mais difficile de ne pas se dire qu’il y a quelque chose qui cloche entre ces extraits et les propos de Rockstar.
Dans quelques semaines, on aura enfin le privilège de tenir la chandelle pour Jason et Lucia. Il faut dire que le duo montre autant de passion à tenter d’épouser le rêve américain en commettant tout un tas de missions périlleuses illégales que lorsqu’ils sont dans la même pièce. Ce jeudi, Rockstar Games a diffusé des images inédites de Grand Theft Auto 6 dans le cadre d’un trailer de lancement qui arrive étonnamment tôt, soit une trentaine de jours avant la journée fatidique du 19 novembre 2026.
Si l’on a bien évidemment bougé la tête et taper du pied grâce au son « Flower in a Hurricane » de Justice en regardant les images, on a aussi pris le temps, après un deuxième visionnage, d’identifier certains détails , que ce soit à propos du passé de Jason Duval ou dans l’épineuse situation dans laquelle Lucia, bracelet électronique au pied, semble se trouver. Au-delà de ça, Rockstar a poussé les potards du spectaculaire d’un cran avec ces images, y compris en ce qui concerne le duo !
Watch the Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer, featuring the debut of “Flower in a Hurricane" from original score composers Justice feat. Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard. Grand Theft Auto VI arrives November 19: https://t.co/WC41QIhkKd pic.twitter.com/KpnUHs47JC
Tandis que les hélicoptères n’ont pas l’air de faire long feu lorsque Jason est dans les parages, c’est surtout la complicité sentimentale et physique du duo à laquelle on ne s’attendait pas forcément en lançant les 90 secondes de ce « launch trailer ». Effectivement, les scènes sous la douche laissent peu de place à la relation qui lie Jason et Lucia dans Grand Theft Auto 6 . Et puis, une fois de plus, le choix de la bande son pour illustrer ces images est sûrement loin d’être anodin, comme c’est le cas pour l’album du jeu .
Pour autant, en poussant l’image que l’on a de la relation de nos deux héros à l’extrême, Rockstar Games semble se contredire. Ou du moins, Rockstar nous met des bâtons dans les roues lorsqu’il s’agit de comprendre où ils veulent en venir . Effectivement, on a du mal à savoir où les développeurs veulent nous emmener avec ce tandem de criminels. Parce que oui, c’est indéniable qu’ils forment le moteur de l’intrigue et de ce sixième volet numéroté, mais jusqu’à quel point ?
Lors de la révélation des informations issues de la présentation à laquelle certains médias et créateurs de contenu triés sur le volet ont assisté, on a compris qu’on allait être littéralement mis aux commandes de cette romance sous haute tension ! À ce moment-là, Rockstar a apporté quelques précisions en expliquant que les deux individus resteraient étroitement liés par le biais de leurs activités criminelles et que leur romance serait facultative , qu’elle évoluerait, dans un sens comme dans l’autre, au bon vouloir du joueur.
En gros, les choix du joueur au cours de l’aventure auront une influence sur le degré d’intimité amoureuse de Jason et Lucia. Mais alors, pourquoi nous montrer un tel niveau d’intimité entre les deux dans ce trailer, si ce n’est pas spécialement représentatif de l’expérience globale ? Pour l’instant, on ne sait pas grand-chose quant au contexte de ces cinématiques où l’on voit Jason et Lucia plus proches que jamais. Peut-être qu’il s’agit d’une temporalité qui n’a rien à voir avec les événements du jeu ou bien un simple outil de communication pour rendre ce spot marketing plus marquant.
Toujours est-il que c’est surprenant de constater que la relation amoureuse entre les deux personnages prend une telle place quand on nous explique que c’est à nous de l’entretenir. Parmi les détails connus, on sait que la ville de Vice City et ses alentours regorgent d’activités que les deux héros peuvent partager . Une séance de musculation, une balade dans un parc, un moment de détente sur un rooftop, cocktail à la main, ou une soirée endiablée dans les rues bardées de néons de Vice City.

articles.t: GTA 6 Has A Dedicated System Just To Control How Much Characters Sweat - EGamers.io - P2E NFT Games Portal
articles.chapeau: Picture Lucia on a Vice City dance floor. When she dances hard, she sweats more, and when she only sways, she sweats less. Someone at Rockstar Games wrote…
articles.txt:
Red Dead Online’s Free August 2026 Update Is Out Now — Here’s Everything In It Picture Lucia on a Vice City dance floor. When she dances hard, she sweats more, and when she only sways, she sweats less. Someone at Rockstar Games wrote the code that makes this work.
It’s the newest detail to come out of GTA 6’s development, and it’s very much the kind of thing Rockstar is known for. Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier says the studio built a separate scripted system with a single task: deciding how much its characters sweat, depending on what they’re doing and how hard they’re doing it.
Nobody leaked or datamined this one. Schreier went to Rockstar North and spoke with developers about how the game is being built. He talked about the sweat system in a video that came out alongside his longer report.
His examples are simple. If Lucia dances hard in a nightclub, she sweats more than if she dances casually. When Jason works out, the sweat on his body goes up or down with how intense the exercise is.
The effect also doesn’t just switch on at random. Based on Schreier’s account, Rockstar tied sweat to each character’s different activities so their reactions would look more natural.
One thing remains unclear: nobody has said whether the system is purely cosmetic or whether it will affect gameplay at all. For now, it’s safest to treat it as something you’ll only notice if you look for it, and most players probably won’t.
It does line up with earlier reports about the game. Players will reportedly be able to train Jason and Lucia and change their physiques, a more advanced version of the body system from GTA: San Andreas. If your characters are hitting the gym, it makes sense that they’d come out drenched.
Getting Vice City right took legwork. Rockstar did extensive research in the real Miami. Developers visited different parts of the city, watched how locals go about their day, and studied details as small as nightclub lighting so the game would feel as convincing as possible.
That helps explain why GTA 6 has taken so long to build. Any studio can put a club in a game. Rockstar sent people to see how the light hits the dance floor, then made sure Lucia’s sweat matches how hard she’s dancing under it.
GTA 6 is currently scheduled to release Nov. 19, 2026 , on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Once it’s out, someone will spend 20 minutes on a Vice City dance floor just to see how damp Lucia gets.

articles.t: GTA 6 Indeed Rated '18'... Depicts Carrying and Snorting Drugs, Sexual Activity, and Decapitation
articles.chapeau: European age rating organization PEGI reportedly published a content rating summary for GTA 6 before taking it down shortly after.
articles.txt:
Why PEGI Briefly Published and Deleted Its '18' Rating Summary for GTA 6
Korean (한국어) KO Add us on European age rating organization PEGI reportedly published a content rating summary for GTA 6 before taking it down shortly after. Notably, the description caught widespread attention by revealing that players can carry cocaine and snort it at any time.
The description was posted on the PEGI website on October 2 and removed on the same day, but word spread quickly as screenshots taken prior to deletion were shared among users. Searching for GTA 6 on the official site currently yields no results. PEGI has not stated the reason for the removal, and Rockstar Games has not issued a separate statement. Because neither party has confirmed the content, it remains officially unconfirmed whether the specific wording represents PEGI's final rating summary.
The PEGI description reportedly characterized drug use as frequent and prominent. Players can use illegal substances directly from their inventory, and cocaine can be carried around and snorted directly off the hand at any time. Partaking in drug use alongside other characters is also reportedly possible. However, the summary does not detail how cocaine affects gameplay systems such as player health or mission mechanics.
Violence centers on realistic gore. Certain weapons allow for detailed decapitation and dismemberment, with players able to harm civilians, criminals, and police officers, as well as animals. Depictions of injuries to animals are reportedly less detailed than those for humans.
Sexual content cited includes nudity, sex scenes, and occasional depictions of sexual fetishes. In various nightclubs, players can pay for private dances and place their hands on the dancer's body. Discriminatory language on television and radio, frequent profanity, and in-game item purchases were also listed among the rating descriptors.
Meanwhile, the US ESRB has reportedly assigned GTA 6 an M (Mature 17+) rating. Neither the ESRB nor PEGI included gambling descriptors, which were present in the Red Dead Redemption series and the PS5 version of GTA 5.
In South Korea, Inven confirmed through reporting that the Game Content Rating Board (GCRB) decided on an Adults Only rating for GTA 6. GTA 6 stands as the most high-profile title reviewed since authority over Adults Only PC and console game ratings was transferred from the Game Rating and Administration Committee (GRAC) to the GCRB on November 1, 2025. Meanwhile, GTA 5 was released in South Korea in 2013 after receiving an Adults Only rating.

articles.t: Un mois avant la sortie de GTA 6 sur consoles, GTA 5 met une nouvelle claque graphique gratuite sur PC, c'est bluffant
articles.chapeau: En attendant GTA 6 le mois prochain, son illustre aîné montre encore qu'il peut asséner une bluffante claque graphique avec ce mod gratuit qui le transforme radicalement.
articles.txt:
En attendant GTA 6 le mois prochain, son illustre aîné montre encore qu'il peut asséner une bluffante claque graphique avec ce mod gratuit qui le transforme radicalement.
13 ans après sa sortie, l'indécrottable GTA 5 ne peut compter que sur GTA 6 à venir le 19 novembre prochain pour le détrôner en tant qu'énorme phénomène culturel dans une simulation de vie de bandit de grand chemin dans un vaste monde ouvert. Alors que le prochain titre mastodonte de Rockstar devrait repousser les limites techniques des PS5 et Xbox Series avec son moteur maison RAGE 9, son ancêtre montre qu'il a encore de très beaux restes grâce au mode AuraV de KBase, qui apporte divers éléments comme le path tracing et des nuages volumétriques pour qu'il n'ait absolument pas à rougir de jeux nettement plus récents que lui, du moins sur PC.
Grâce à sa version Enhanced sortie il y a quelques mois sur PC, GTA 5 a pu se mettre à la page graphiquement pour montrer qu'il en a encore dans le ventre, à défaut de pouvoir jouer à GTA 6 le 19 novembre 2026 sur PC. Rockstar oblige, il sortira en effet d'abord sur consoles. Qu'à cela ne tienne, KBase a ainsi mis à disposition gratuitement son mod AuraV qui transforme radicalement son vénérable aîné.
« AuraV est un mod graphique gratuit pour GTA V Enhanced sur PC. Il utilise le path tracing pour l'éclairage, recrée le ciel avec des nuages ​​volumétriques et une nouvelle atmosphère, donne à l'océan des vagues façonnées par le vent, et retravaille la pluie, les éclairs, le miroitement de la chaleur, la fumée ainsi que l'éclairage de la peau », indique le site officiel du mod.
Ce mod graphique très complet de GTA 5 ajoute ainsi pléthore de fonctionnalités qui poussent le titre dans ses derniers retranchements graphiques, qui pourraient même faire pâlir de jalousie certains étalons visuels plus récents :

articles.t: GTA 6 : combien de copies Take-Two doit vendre pour rembourser le jeu le plus cher de l’histoire
articles.chapeau: Take-Two ne publie aucun budget pour GTA 6. Ses comptes, le prix du jeu et la commission de Sony et de Microsoft suffisent pourtant à estimer son point mort.
articles.txt:
Avec un prix de 79,99 euros, la commission des boutiques de Sony et de Microsoft et les hypothèses de coût qui circulent, GTA 6 doit se vendre entre 20 et 50 millions d'exemplaires pour rentrer dans ses frais. Newzoo prévoit 37 millions de ventes cumulées à la fin de la semaine de lancement dans son scénario bas et 51 millions dans son scénario central, précommandes comprises.
Si le scénario central se vérifie, GTA 6 pourrait rembourser un budget de deux milliards de dollars dès sa semaine de lancement, à partir du 19 novembre. Le scénario bas suffirait pour un budget d'un milliard de dollars, voire de 1,5 milliard selon la recette retenue ; au-delà, le point mort dépendrait des ventes des semaines suivantes, que Newzoo ne chiffre pas. Sa réussite financière se mesurera plutôt à sa durée de vie et à la place que prendra un mode en ligne qui n'existe pas encore.
Jennifer Kolbe, qui dirige l'édition chez Rockstar, a refusé de donner le moindre chiffre à Bloomberg. Elle a seulement démenti que son développement ait coûté plus de 1,5 milliard de dollars, le prix de construction de la Burj Khalifa auquel une rumeur l'avait comparé. Pour Jason Schreier, venu à Édimbourg retracer la genèse du jeu , GTA 6 reste presque à coup sûr le jeu vidéo le plus cher jamais produit.
Business Insider avançait une fourchette d'un à 1,5 milliard de dollars à partir d'estimations d'analystes, rapporte IGN, sans que Strauss Zelnick, le PDG de Take-Two , aille plus loin que d'admettre un jeu « cher ». Le chiffre de deux milliards de dollars circulait déjà en 2022 avant que Gulf News le reprenne en 2025, sans confirmation. Les montants de trois milliards et plus viennent d'un vidéaste et d'internautes qui ont additionné les salaires déclarés par Rockstar au Royaume-Uni, puis prolongé la courbe jusqu'à la sortie. NME et GamingBolt les ont relayés au printemps en les présentant comme des estimations.
Les documents officiels donnent au moins l'échelle. Rockstar Games UK, la filiale britannique du groupe, a déclaré au registre des sociétés 363 millions de livres de frais de personnel sur l'exercice clos fin mars 2025, pour 1 744 salariés en moyenne, après 404 millions l'année précédente. Ses comptes donnent pour adresse d'exploitation les bureaux de Rockstar North à Édimbourg. Ces sommes couvrent tout ce que produit la filiale, GTA Online compris. Rockstar comptait 4 711 salariés dans douze bureaux en août 2026 selon Bloomberg, presque deux fois plus qu'à la sortie de Red Dead Redemption 2 .
Le rapport annuel de Take-Two fournit le seul chiffre consolidé. Au 31 mars 2026, l'éditeur portait à son bilan 2,15 milliards de dollars de coûts de développement capitalisés pour des jeux pas encore sortis, salaires et rémunérations en actions compris, déduction faite des aides publiques. GTA 6 en représente vraisemblablement la plus grosse part. La somme englobe pourtant les autres productions du groupe, s'arrête huit mois avant la sortie et laisse de côté le marketing comme les dépenses engagées avant que le projet soit jugé techniquement faisable.
Le prix affiché comprend d'abord la TVA. En France, à 20 %, l'édition Standard vendue 79,99 euros sur le PlayStation Store et le Microsoft Store représente 66,66 euros hors taxes. La boutique de la console se sert ensuite. Microsoft a reconnu en 2021, au procès qui opposait Epic à Apple, prélever 30 % sur les jeux vendus dans la boutique de la Xbox. Le même taux chez Sony est contesté par l'action collective menée au Royaume-Uni par Alex Neill au nom des joueurs, dont le procès s'est ouvert en mars 2026 devant le Competition Appeal Tribunal de Londres. Aucune des trois entreprises ne dit si Take-Two a négocié un taux plus bas pour GTA 6.
Avec 30 % de commission, une copie numérique vendue en France laisse 46,66 euros à Take-Two (58,33 euros pour l'Édition Ultime à 99,99 euros). Aux États-Unis, où les 79,99 dollars s'entendent hors taxe de vente, l'éditeur touche environ 56 dollars. Son rapport annuel confirme le mécanisme, puisque pour les ventes sur PlayStation , Xbox et Steam, Take-Two ne comptabilise que ce que la boutique lui reverse.
Les boîtes sont plus opaques. Elles ne contiennent qu'un code de téléchargement et descendent à 60 euros chez E.Leclerc, mais personne ne publie la part que gardent le distributeur, le magasin et le fabricant de la console. articles.t: Weekly Recap: GTA 6's Final Trailer Steals The Spotlight As Hardware Sales Slide - EGamers.io - P2E NFT Games Portal
articles.chapeau: A single trailer dominated the past seven days. Rockstar released its last GTA 6 trailer, leaving nearly every other gaming story to compete for the…
articles.txt:
GTA 6 Becomes Top Anticipated Game, Research Indicates A single trailer dominated the past seven days. Rockstar released its last GTA 6 trailer, leaving nearly every other gaming story to compete for the attention that remained.
Every week, we collect the stories our readers clicked on most, based on our own traffic data. If the wave of announcements, rumors and reveals passed you by, this is the place to catch up.
The week’s top story was the final GTA 6 trailer . Close behind it was speculation about a PC version of the game. For now, consider that PC talk a rumor, since none of this week’s news backs it up.
Elsewhere, gaming coverage was more down-to-earth. Readers could pick up new free games, check out this month’s PS Plus additions, and read about updates for both Steam and PlayStation 5. There was also news of a collector’s bundle for God of War fans.
On the entertainment side, big franchises you already know made most of the headlines. Both Avengers: Doomsday and The Beekeeper 2 got updates. A new X-Files project made the list as well, which shows just how long nostalgia can carry a series.
Several well-known actors are stepping back into old roles, and Netflix and HBO Max have more series on the way. If your watchlist already looks crowded, expect it to grow.
Tech news struck the most sobering note. Sales dropped sharply in both the smartphone and PC markets. That makes for a rough backdrop for every company hoping to sell you a new device this fall.
Apple still had fresh announcements to share. Microsoft said it plans to speed up Windows 11. Judge that promise once you’ve tried the update on your own machine.
This week’s outlier was a story about how we measure time. It made the list next to a handful of new tech ideas that caught readers’ interest, proof that people will click on more than spec sheets and sales charts.
If you can only fit in one thing, make it the GTA 6 trailer. As for Microsoft’s faster Windows 11, wait until it actually ships before you take the claim at face value.

articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto est une licence qui a toujours défrayé la chronique ou apporté au jeu vidéo un nouvel angle d’approche. De l’histoire aux actions à réaliser, en passant par les évolutions techniques du monde ouvert en 3D, la licence de Rockstar Games a toujours marqué de son empreinte le média. Après 13 ans d’attente, GTA s’apprête à faire son grand retour avec GTA 6, sans conteste le jeu le plus attendu et scruté de l’histoire. Si vous faites partie des joueurs qui ne manqueront pas la sortie le 19 novembre prochain, vous pouvez actuellement précommander la version boîte PS5 de Grand Theft Auto au meilleur prix chez E. Leclerc. Normalement affichée au prix de 79,99 euros, cette version boîte comprenant un code de téléchargement est disponible à 60 euros. Un prix accompagné du Prix Bas Garanti et d’un pack bonus dont vous pourrez profiter en jeu. À la demande de l’éditeur et afin de vous permettre de jouer dès la sortie, les livraisons débuteront dès le 12 novembre 2026.
Vice City, aux États-Unis. Dans cette version fictive de Miami et, plus largement, de la Floride, vivent Jason et Lucia, un duo de personnages qui ont toujours su que la vie ne leur ferait pas de cadeau. Poussés par l’envie de repartir sur de bonnes bases, ils découvrent vite la face sombre de la région et replongent dans leur passé criminel en s’impliquant malgré eux dans une dynamique qui les dépasse. Offrant un immense terrain de jeu explorable librement et hébergeant des missions scénarisées ou des activités parallèles, le titre promet une expérience aussi libre que détaillée et cinématographique, poussant les consoles modernes dans leurs retranchements. Au cœur de tout cela se trouvent des séquences d’action intenses, des personnages marquants, de très nombreux véhicules à obtenir et des centaines de pistes musicales à écouter. Évidemment, Rockstar a intégré de nombreux secrets qui ne manqueront pas de plaire aux enquêteurs virtuels ni de générer de nombreuses théories.
Le Prix Bas Garanti d’E. Leclerc vous permet de ne payer que la somme la plus basse affichée avant la sortie du produit commandé. Quel que soit le montant auquel vous avez effectué la réservation, vous ne devrez débourser que la somme la plus basse.

articles.t: Un nouveau trailer pour GTA 6, des Galaxy ne redémarrent plus depuis One UI 9, c’est le récap’, de la semaine.
articles.chapeau: Rockstar dévoile un nouveau trailer de GTA 6, One UI 9 empêche certains Galaxy de démarrer, WhatsApp permet enfin de programmer vos messages sur Android,
articles.txt:
Clio Leonard 18/10/2026 06:50 Partager Partager Copier Rockstar dévoile un nouveau trailer de GTA 6, One UI 9 empêche certains Galaxy de démarrer, WhatsApp permet enfin de programmer vos messages sur Android, c’est le récap’ de la semaine.
Cette semaine, Rockstar publie un nouveau trailer de GTA 6 à un mois de la sortie. Du côté de Samsung, alors que la mise à jour One UI 9 pose problème à certains utilisateurs, le constructeur prépare une caméra selfie carrée pour ses Galaxy S27. WhatsApp ajoute enfin la programmation des messages sur Android et Sony n’arrive pas à faire disparaître une boutique pirate de jeux PS5.
Huit mois après les premiers tests en internet, WhatsApp commence à déployer la programmation des messages sur Android. La fonction est pour l’instant réservée à certains testeurs de bêta. Il suffit d’écrire son message, puis d’appuyer longuement sur le bouton d’envoi pour choisir la date et l’heure. Le message par même si l’application est fermée. Il faut le programmer au moins 10 minutes à l’avance et au maximum deux semaines avant.
Lire : WhatsApp est enfin compatible avec la programmation de messages sur Android
Plusieurs propriétaires de Galaxy, du S24 au S26 en passant par quelques Z, voient leur téléphone planter en fin d’installation de One UI 9. Un message d’erreur s’affiche et le smartphone ne va pas jusqu’à l’écran d’accueil. Bonne nouvelle, le souci viendrait des serveurs de Samsung, donc votre téléphone n’est pas hors service ! Pour finir l’installation, il vous suffit de redémarrer l’appareil en mode sans échec, ce qui coupe le WiFi et les données mobiles. Vous pouvez aussi choisir l’option d’éteindre votre box ou de retirer la carte SIM.
Lire : One UI 9 : cette erreur terrifiante bloque la mise à jour sur certains Samsung Galaxy, voici comment la régler
Samsung préparer un capteur selfie au format carré de 16 MP qui permettrait de prendre des selfies de groupe en gardant le téléphone à la verticale. Selon GalaxyClub, seuls les Galaxy S27 Pro et S27 Ultra en profiteraient, alors que les S27 et S27+ garderaient leur caméra actuelle. Apple a lancé la tendance avec l’iPhone 17 et Samsung devrait proposer quelque chose d’assez similaire.

Depuis que la PS5 peut être jailbreakée, certains joueurs ont accès à une boutique pirate baptisée Overdrive. Elle permet de télécharger plus de 1600 jeux gratuitement sur une console modifiée. Son dépôt GitHub, c’est-à-dire la page où elle était hébergée, a fini par afficher une erreur 404. Sony aurait envoyé une mise en demeure à l’auteur, mais personne ne l’a confirmé pour l’instant. Ça n’a pas servi à grand-chose, des dizaines de copies ont été publiées sur GitHub dans la foulée, avec parfois un mode d’emploi pour passer à la nouvelle version.

Rockstar Games a publié une bande-annonce de 1 minute 30 pour GTA 6, avec des images capturées en jeu sur PS5. On y voit des cascades à moto, des explosions, une course-poursuite avec la police, un braquage de banque et des fusillades. La musique vient du duo français Justice, dont le nouveau single est disponible sur les plateformes de streaming. Les fans ont aussi repéré un bracelet électronique à la cheville de Lucia, un détail qui pourrait compter dans l’histoire. La sortie approche à grands pas puisque le jeu sera enfin disponible à partir du 19 novembre 2025 sur PS5 et Xbox Series.

For millions of gamers, November is all about one video game: Grand Theft Auto 6 . Rockstar’s much-anticipated open-world crime game is likely to spark a cultural moment that we haven’t seen in games since Animal Crossing: New Horizons in 2020. While that’s exciting, it’s also bound to leave players who don’t care about GTA a little bored considering that so many developers have moved their games out of November entirely to avoid getting lost in the storm.
The good news for anyone looking for some good GTA 6 counter-programming is that there are more games coming out next month. While it’s not as crowded a field as we typically get in November, there’s still sure to be something for you. Here’s a look at some of the highlights you can expect to play if you’re avoiding the streets of Vice City.
In a crowded Gamescom Opening Night Live stream, Gravhounds was a real attention-grabber. The upcoming co-op shooter puts you and your friends in control of gun-toting dogs forced to shoot their way through an alien planet. With base building mechanics and some gravity-bending physics to toy with, it could wind up being a goofy multiplayer hit. It’s set to launch into early access starting on Nov. 2.
Where to play: Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Windows PC, Xbox Series X
Anyone who grew up in the GameCube era will no doubt remember Godzilla: Destroy All Monster Melee , if only for its iconic cover art. 24 years after its release, the cult classic kaiju brawler is returning in a freshly remastered form complete with online multiplayer. If you’ve never played it, don’t sleep on it: It’s a surprisingly fun casual fighting game that’s filled with classic monsters.
Arguably, World of Warcraft: Forever is as big a deal as GTA 6 — at least for a specific era of players. Blizzard is embracing 2000s nostalgia by creating an all-new version of its legendary MMO that features retro graphics and brand-new content. It’s a dream come true for players who have just always wanted more from World of Warcraft , but as they remember it back in its heyday.
Considering that GTA 6 isn’t coming to Switch 2, we always knew that Nintendo would need to pull out the big guns to counter-program it. It doesn’t get much bigger than a remake of the greatest game of all time. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is getting a modern makeover complete with dreamy visuals, modernized controls, and even a jump button.
For those looking for a multiplayer game to play in lieu of GTA 6 missing an opportunity for co-op, Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School is your best bet. The multiplayer puzzle game will drop you and a pal into a series of escape rooms designed by people who used to make them in real life. articles.txt:
GTA 6 Community Map Version 17 adds numerous buildings, roads, landmarks, and confirmed interiors across Vice City and Leonida. Based on leaked minimaps, gameplay footage, and promotional scenes, the update improves locations such as Port Gellhorn, Waning Sands, Stockyard, and Starfish Island. As players prepare to explore GTA 6’s increasingly detailed world and discover new opportunities to earn in-game currency, interest in options to buy GTA 6 Money may also grow. Although the map now provides a more detailed view of the game’s world, additional locations and interiors remain to be identified.
The latest update covers several important regions, from southern Vice City to northern Leonida. The following table summarizes some of the most notable additions.
Northern Key Lento receives substantial improvements, with new buildings and roads reconstructed using information from earlier cyber leaks. The Hamlet region also gains additional details based on leaked aircraft and hypercar footage, while Bluegrass now features farms, villas, and orchards.
The map's color coding also provides useful information about potential interiors. Blue buildings indicate locations confirmed to have interiors, either through visible interior footage or their appearance on in-game minimaps. However, gray buildings should not automatically be considered inaccessible, as many interiors remain unidentified.
Other rural improvements include additional fields around Ambrosia, details for Tucker's Citrus Farm, and a revised boundary in northern Leonida County. Some agricultural fields even appear to form an American flag when viewed in-game.
Several major landmarks have been added or refined. The Port Gellhorn prison now has a more accurate outline, while the nearby raceway receives additional buildings. A Ferris wheel identified in older leaks has also been placed in southern Port Gellhorn.
Waning Sands gains the Evergreen Mall, inspired by Orlando's real-world outlet shopping destinations. Although it appears to be one of the largest shopping complexes in GTA 6, its open-air design means it will not function entirely like an enclosed shopping mall. The area also includes Pier 66 Marina and a golf driving range, correcting an earlier map identification.
In other regions, Goliath's large concrete factory receives more detail, and additional buildings and roads improve Ambrosia and surrounding communities.
Vice City accounts for a significant portion of Version 17's improvements. Downtown, Little Cuba, Stockyard, Rockridge, and Crosstown all receive additional buildings or location details. A hospital has also been identified in the Rockridge and Crosstown area.
Stockyard stands out because its map contains a particularly high concentration of confirmed interiors. The project also incorporates in-game icons for stores, hospitals, and restaurants. Some stores may be robbable, potentially giving players additional opportunities to earn money during free roam.
The casino has been added to northern Vice City, while Starfish Island now features several mansions based on real-life properties. One particularly large mansion has been suggested as a possible inspiration for the Vers Estate from GTA: Vice City, although this identification remains unconfirmed.
Vice Beach and South Beach have also received substantial improvements. Several hotels and a multi-story shopping complex appear to be enterable, while extended promotional footage has helped mappers identify buildings throughout Washington Beach, Bay Shore, Bay Harbor, and the hospital island.
These resources allow fans to explore identified locations and compare the mapped world with real-life geography. As players prepare for GTA 6's release and look forward to exploring its expansive world, those planning their in-game spending may also consider options for cheap GTA 6 Money to support their adventures.
With Version 17, the GTA 6 community map offers a clearer picture of Leonida's scale, architectural variety, and potential interior density. More leaked footage, screenshots, and official promotional material could reveal additional locations before launch.
The project remains a work in progress, but its expanding level of detail is helping fans better understand the world they will eventually explore in GTA 6.

articles.t: GTA 6 : Copies de test bientôt disponibles, classification mondiale et dernières infos
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 approche de sa sortie et l
articles.txt:
GTA 6 approche de sa sortie et l'actualité s'accélère autour du prochain jeu de Rockstar Games. Alors que la bande-annonce de lancement suscite un énorme intérêt, plusieurs informations attirent l'attention : la distribution potentielle des copies de test, les classifications par âge dans le monde, l'éligibilité aux Game Awards 2026 et les premières analyses techniques.
Le jeu est toujours attendu le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S. Voici les dernières informations à connaître avant son lancement. En attendant, Argent GTA 6 reste un sujet fréquent parmi les joueurs qui se préparent à l'économie du jeu.
L'une des nouvelles les plus importantes concerne les copies de test destinées aux journalistes et aux médias spécialisés. Selon l'insider Nate the Hate, ces versions n'auraient pas encore été distribuées, mais elles devraient arriver avant la fin du mois d'octobre.
Cette information provient d'une réponse publiée sur le forum ResetEra, où l'informateur répondait à une question concernant la distribution des copies de presse. Son message indique que les exemplaires ne sont pas encore disponibles, mais qu'ils devraient être envoyés avant la fin du mois.
Il faut toutefois rester prudent : Rockstar Games n'a pas officiellement confirmé ce calendrier. Il s'agit d'une information provenant d'un insider, et non d'une annonce du studio.
Si cette prévision se confirme, les journalistes pourraient disposer de plusieurs semaines pour explorer GTA 6 avant sa sortie. Ce délai serait particulièrement utile pour un jeu de cette ampleur, dont le monde ouvert, les activités secondaires et les mécaniques devraient demander beaucoup de temps pour être évalués.
Les tests ne se limiteront probablement pas à terminer l'histoire principale. Les journalistes devront également explorer Vice City et Leonida, découvrir les activités disponibles et examiner les systèmes qui donnent vie au monde ouvert. Une période de test prolongée pourrait donc permettre des critiques plus complètes.
La date exacte de publication des tests reste inconnue. Rockstar n'a pas annoncé publiquement le moment où l'embargo sera levé.
Si les copies de test arrivent effectivement avant la fin octobre, les médias pourraient disposer d'un temps de jeu conséquent avant le lancement du 19 novembre. Cependant, il ne faut pas confondre la date de distribution des versions de presse avec celle de publication des critiques.
Les joueurs devront attendre une confirmation officielle pour connaître le calendrier précis. En attendant, les informations concernant les copies de test doivent être considérées comme des rumeurs crédibles, mais non confirmées.
Les classifications par âge constituent un autre sujet important à l'approche du lancement. Elles donnent des indications sur les contenus susceptibles de ne pas convenir aux plus jeunes, notamment la violence, les drogues et le langage.
Aux États-Unis, GTA 6 a reçu la classification Mature 17+ de l'ESRB. En Allemagne, l'organisme USK lui a attribué la classification 18 ans et plus. D'autres marchés disposent de leurs propres systèmes d'évaluation, avec des catégories destinées aux adultes.
La classification allemande mentionne notamment la violence intense, les drogues et les représentations d'activités criminelles. Les braquages et les courses de rue illégales font partie des exemples associés à l'univers du jeu.
Ces décisions ne sont pas particulièrement surprenantes pour une franchise comme Grand Theft Auto. Depuis ses débuts, la série met en scène des criminels, des affrontements avec la police et des activités illégales dans un monde ouvert. GTA 6 semble poursuivre cette approche avec une représentation adulte de son univers.
Il faut toutefois distinguer les classifications officielles des interprétations qui circulent en ligne. Les organismes n'utilisent pas tous les mêmes critères et ne publient pas nécessairement les mêmes détails. Une classification adulte ne permet pas non plus, à elle seule, de conclure que le jeu contient un élément précis qui n'a pas été confirmé.
Certaines évaluations mentionnent également les achats intégrés. Cette indication ne signifie pas automatiquement que le mode solo proposera des microtransactions. Il faudra attendre les informations officielles de Rockstar pour connaître précisément les fonctionnalités commerciales du jeu.
GTA 6 pourrait également participer aux Game Awards 2026. Selon les règles d'éligibilité publiées par l'organisation, les jeux doivent sortir avant la date limi

articles.t: The White House mocks GTA 6 with Tesla
articles.chapeau: The White House released a viral image of Trump in GTA style mocking the delays of the video game after the presentation of the Tesla Roadster Cyberfie.
articles.txt:
The official account of the White House on X launched a viral joke this Friday that combined politics, technology, and popular culture: it published an AI-generated image of Donald Trump walking next to a futuristic, hovering car with propellers, while Marine One flew over the scene, and the slogan "Make America Great Again" was written in the distinctive font of Grand Theft Auto.
The message accompanying the image was direct: "We really got flying cars before GTA 6."
The publication came a day after Elon Musk unveiled the new Tesla Roadster Cyberfie at the SpaceX rocket testing facilities in McGregor, Texas, where the vehicle performed autonomous maneuvers that left the audience speechless: it ascended a nearly vertical ramp, drove upside down, flew over a line of Tesla vehicles, and completed a full rotation in the air that the Vice President of Engineering, Lars Moravy, dubbed the "kick flip."
The joke about the White House has a double irony that did not go unnoticed. On one hand, GTA 6 —developed by Rockstar Games and one of the most anticipated video games in history— has been facing delays for years and is scheduled to be released on November 19, 2026 .
On the other hand, the Tesla Roadster will not be in the hands of consumers before 2028 , and its flight capability—achieved through cold gas thrusters using aerospace technology from SpaceX—is not approved for use on public roads.
Trump, asked by a journalist from Fox News , responded with moderate enthusiasm: "I'm very happy for Elon," he said, describing the car as "quite impressive, very impressive," although he added that he wasn't sure if he would be seen inside the vehicle.
The joke comes just a week after Trump presented Musk with the National Medal of Science at the "Science: A New Golden Age" summit at the White House, where he referred to him as a "national treasure" and compared him to Thomas Edison.
It was the first time that Trump personally presented these medals during either of his two administrations.
The Cyberfie Roadster, according to information about the unveiling of Tesla's flying car , accelerated from zero to 60 mph in 0.81 seconds and uses two 600-liter tanks of compressed air released through ten nozzles.
Tesla confirmed three versions: the Performance, with a reservation of 50,000 dollars ; the Thrust, with a reservation of 250,000 dollars ; and the Rocket, available only by invitation. Musk later indicated that certain versions could exceed 400 mph, more than half the speed of sound.
This is not the first time that the Trump administration has turned to popular culture to viralize its message.
The White House has a history that includes Trump characterized as a Green Lantern superhero in a video that surpassed 19 million views in September, and as a Mandalorian warrior for Star Wars Day in May. The administration has also used memes of Mario and Naruto that caused diplomatic tensions with Japan.
The post on Friday amassed nearly 3.8 million views and more than 98,000 "likes" within a few hours, reinforcing the White House's digital communication strategy as one of the most active on social media.
The first prototype of the Roadster was presented in 2017 with a promise of production by 2020, which means that the vehicle has already accumulated at least eight years of delays—almost as many as GTA 6 itself.

articles.t: 'GTA 6': Is PS5 Pro the best way to experience the game at launch?
articles.chapeau: Short answer: Probably?
articles.txt:
As we sift through the latest leaked gameplay videos for Grand Theft Auto VI , it's worth wondering: Which console will provide the most high-end experience when the game launches on Nov. 19?
The answer would usually be PC, but Rockstar has not announced a PC version of GTA 6 yet, and might not for a while. GTA V didn't launch on PC until two years later , after all. With that in mind, people are wondering if it's worth it to splurge on a PlayStation 5 Pro just to experience Vice City at the highest level of fidelity possible.
Rockstar has yet to share official visual and performance specs for any version of the game just yet, but let's investigate anyway with what little information we have.
This is the big question, and it's one we don't really have an answer to right now.
Rockstar's official marketing line for the last few months has been that GTA VI "plays best on PS5," but that tagline doesn't say anything about PS5 Pro. It also doesn't say much of anything in general, as we have no idea what the differences will be between the base PS5 and the Xbox Series X versions of GTA VI . It's not an exaggeration to say that we're operating with almost no useful information about the way this game performs on consoles right now, aside from the fact that the extended Netflix trailer was apparently captured on a base PS5.
There has been one recent little crumb of hope that the PS5 Pro version of the game is an upgrade over the base version, though. A recently released screenshot of a wet city street at night showcased high-quality reflections that don't seem to be present in the base PS5 build shown on Netflix or in any other marketing. Oliver Mackenzie of Digital Foundry , an outlet dedicated to technical analysis of game visuals, said on X that this screenshot may not represent regular PS5 gameplay.
Mackenzie estimates that these reflections use ray tracing, a relatively recent technology that generates real-time, high-quality lighting and reflections, while requiring a pretty intense amount of horsepower.
Base PS5 games technically can and do utilize ray tracing on occasion; the reflections in the Marvel's Spider-Man series on PS5 are a good go-to example. But given the extremely high level of graphical detail present in GTA 6 , it stands to reason that the game might not be able to use ray tracing on a base PS5, but could possibly include that feature on PS5 Pro.
It must be emphasized that this is all speculation based on one measly screenshot, which might not even show the console version of the game at all. Rockstar very well could have captured it using an internal PC build, as Mackenzie noted on X. But there is plenty of precedent for games like Ghost of Yotei locking the best ray tracing features behind PS5 Pro-exclusive modes, so it's possible GTA VI could do the same.
A PS5 Pro retails for $900 at the moment, and that's under the best of conditions, as a recent shortage has driven up the price on the secondary market considerably (as high as $1,300). It is perfectly reasonable to not want to spend that much money on a gaming device, no matter how powerful it is, and no matter how much better GTA 6 might look on it — emphasis on might .
But, as a PS5 Pro owner myself, I will say that games rarely (if ever) look or run worse on PS5 Pro, and big-budget AAA productions often benefit in some way from the added horsepower. A couple of my favorite games of this console generation, Dragon's Dogma 2 and Death Stranding 2 , look and perform absolutely wonderfully on PS5 Pro, just to provide two examples.
If you care about having the best graphics in every game, a PC is the way to go. But if you don't want a PC — or if the game you want to play isn't being released on PC for the foreseeable future — then the PS5 Pro is your second-best option. Just try not to spend too much more than $900 on it.
In the meantime, you can pre-order Grand Theft Auto VI for Xbox Series X/S and PS5 for $79.99.
Alex Perry is a tech reporter at Mashable who primarily covers video games and consumer tech. Alex has spent most of the last decade reviewing games, smartphones, headphones, and laptops, and he doesn’t plan on stopping anytime soon. He is also a Pisces, a cat lover, and a Kansas City sports fan. Alex can be found on Bluesky at yelix.bsky.social .

articles.t: GTA 6 Launch Trailer Shows No Sign of PS5's QSSR Upscaler, Digital Foundry Finds - Shane the Gamer
articles.chapeau: Digital Foundry's look at GTA 6's launch trailer finds base PS5 still at 1440p to 4K with no QSSR, but an old RAGE animation judder appears to be gone.
articles.txt:
Vice City slides past at 30fps on a standard PS5 . The image is still being rebuilt from around 1440p, and Sony’s brand-new AI upscaler isn’t doing the rebuilding. Digital Foundry’s frame-by-frame breakdown of the Grand Theft Auto VI launch trailer found no evidence of the feature and questions if the higher latency would be worth it. That’s a blow to anyone hoping QSSR would arrive in time for the game’s November 19 release.
It isn’t all bad news for base console owners. The same analysis says one of the RAGE engine’s oldest problems, a judder in animations during camera moves, looks like it’s finally been fixed.
Most of the arguing online has been about whether the trailer looks softer than Rockstar’s earlier footage:
Eurogamer @eurogamer.bsky.social GTA 6 leaker shows off the game's ending in new video as they indicate the leaks may have come to an end www.eurogamer.net/gta-6-cyberl... 0 replies 3 reposts 7 likes 14 Oct 2026
Some viewers came away from the trailer convinced the picture had got worse. Notebookcheck’s write-up of the Digital Foundry piece notes that the most common criticism of the GTA 6 launch trailer is its hazy appearance. The blurriness softens the visuals, while excessive bloom fades the vibrant colors.
The numbers don’t support a downgrade. DF counted no change in resolution, and the site also believes Rockstar maintained a 1440p resolution, upscaled to a 4K output. Its explanation for the haze is narrower: the changed look may be specific to this particular PS5 footage. DF did flag the HDR presentation as a weak spot.
The real headline for tech nerds is motion. In earlier footage, the frame rate stayed steady but animation timing didn’t, so slow camera pans had a subtle stutter. French outlet Xboxygen traces the quirk back to GTA IV in 2008. Digital Foundry spotted it again in the extended gameplay look Rockstar put out in August.
In the launch trailer it seems to be gone. DF went looking in the slow pans where it usually shows up and didn’t find it. It’s hedging, though. As Xboxygen points out, the trailer runs for roughly 90 seconds, and Rockstar picks its own shots. Only the retail build will settle whether the fix goes all the way down to the engine.
QSSR stands for Quick Spectral Super Resolution. Sony announced it on the PlayStation Blog on October 1 in a post by Daniel Craig, principal engineer in SIE’s graphics R&D group, who called it a new performance tier of AI upscaling. It came out of Project Amethyst, Sony’s AI graphics partnership with AMD, and runs on a streamlined neural network architecture tuned specifically for the base PS5.
Marvel’s Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei got patches adding it on day one. Sony also says it’s open to every PlayStation developer, which is why GTA 6 got dragged into the conversation straight away. Sony hasn’t oversold it, either. Its own line is that “While PSSR remains the gold standard on PS5 Pro, QSSR provides some notable improvements to both image detail and image stability on PS5”.
QSSR has a cost, and Digital Foundry’s Wolverine testing puts a figure on it. Rebuilding an image from about 864p to 1440p took about 1,5-1,8 ms more time per frame than Insomniac’s proprietary upscaler. With an unlocked frame rate, this corresponded to a difference of approximately 8-10 FPS. Push the output to 2160p and the QSSR load in the Wolverine test increased to approximately 4.4 ms per frame.
GTA 6 outputs at 4K, so that heavier number is the one that counts. A 30fps game has 33.3ms to draw each frame. Losing more than 4ms of that in an open world this dense isn’t trivial.
Then there’s integration. Back when QSSR launched, Digital Foundry noted that in earlier GTA 6 PS5 trailers, Digital Foundry found no evidence of FSR or a modern temporal approach. As a result, it may be trickier to introduce the latest advancements. Games already running AMD’s FSR, like Ghost of Yotei, have an easier swap. TweakTown adds that a post-launch patch is possible, but Rockstar has not announced QSSR support, and integrating it into the game’s rendering pipeline may be challenging.
Read also: GTA 6 Will Reportedly Stream Only on Xbox Cloud Gaming at Launch, Opening a Door for PC
Here’s our view: missing QSSR is fine. Rockstar has been locking down a game this size for years. Bolting a weeks-old upscaler onto the rendering pipeline a month out from launch is exactly how you end up with a day-one patch nobody wanted. A smooth, consistent 30fps with the judder gone is worth more than

articles.t: 'I Don't Think We're Seeing It Here': GTA 6 Launch Trailer Not Using PS5's New QSSR Upscaler | Push Square
articles.chapeau: "That
articles.txt:
Sony introduced QSSR earlier this month , bringing a version of the PS5 Pro’s acclaimed PSSR upscaler to base PS5 hardware.
While the technology is currently only incorporated into first-party titles Marvel’s Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei , it will be made available to third-party devs as well, with many speculating its introduction may have been timed specifically to coincide with GTA 6 .
(Which, according to Rockstar’s marketing, will “ play best on PS5 ”.)
However, tech experts Digital Foundry don’t believe there’s any evidence of its implementation in this week’s launch trailer , which was captured on Sony’s console according to a disclaimer in the video.
Speaking as part of a 20-minute video , Rich Leadbetter said:
“I don’t think we’re seeing it here. If the internal rendering resolution is 1440p, then what is QSSR doing? If it’s going to be upscaling to 4K, based on the numbers we have looking at Quality Mode in Marvel’s Wolverine, you’re looking at 4ms to do an upscale to 4K. And if you’ve got a 33ms render budget, that’s well over 10% of your rendering budget just on QSSR. That’s quite extravagant.
So the question is: if it’s in there, how are they going to use it? And what would it look like if your internal resolution is already relatively high and ‘good enough’. But image quality was one of the things we criticised in the Extended Look, and I’m curious to know what QSSR could bring to the table and the viability of it.”
This is obviously quite complicated analysis from Leadbetter, but he’s essentially saying that QSSR may not be the right fit for GTA 6 if the game is already targeting a resolution that scales adequately to 4K screens. (In this instance, native 1440p.)
In particular, he notes that the processing cost he observed in Marvel’s Wolverine would eat quite significantly into GTA 6’s rendering budget, and it’s not clear how this would necessarily benefit the game.
Of course, this launch trailer was likely captured using older footage, and it’s entirely possible things may change for the final product, due out on 19th November.
But as of right now, there’s no evidence of QSSR. I’m sure a lot more will be said and written about GTA 6’s visuals on PS5 hardware once the final product is out in the wild.

Before GTA 6, Rockstar's Attempt at School Satire Faced an Era of Intense Censorship - AOL
articles.chapeau: The GTA developer’s schoolboy sandbox had calls for censorship before it was even released.
articles.txt:
0 Rockstar is one of the most celebrated video game developers in the world, creating blockbuster franchises like Red Dead Redemption and Grand Theft Auto . These iconic games have players exploring massive worlds as they play through darkly comedic campaigns that satirize different eras of America; they also allow players to spread violence and mayhem as they wish, making them as controversial as they are popular. This controversy came to a head in the mid 2000s when Rockstar announced their next game wouldn’t take place in a crime-ridden city: it would take place in a boarding school.
Bully was released on October 17, 2006 on the PlayStation 2. Players take on the role of Jimmy Hopkins, a juvenile delinquent who has been expelled from a handful of schools who now attends Bullworth Academy against his will. As Jimmy tries to take over the different cliques of the school, players can explore the campus and surrounding town, play minigames to attend classes, pull pranks, skateboard, drive go-karts, and more. Bully was widely praised by critics, but had an army of detractors before it even hit shelves.
Given the violent and sexual content of Grand Theft Auto games, there was immediate uproar when it turned out that Rockstar’s next game was set in a school. The game was banned in the country of Brazil for a decade, while similar calls for total censorship were made in Florida —where lawyer Jack Thompson dubbed the game a “Columbine simulator”— and in the United Kingdom , where store chains like PC World refused to carry the game, all before the game was even released.
Bully sold well, but not well enough to justify a second game beyond Scholarship Edition , which brought remastered visuals to more consoles like the Xbox 360. A sequel was briefly in development, but cancelled after layoffs at Rockstar around 2009. The game ended up not being a “Columbine simulator”, but rather a whimsical yet dark satire on American schools, how bullies are made, and how a bully can turn himself into a hero.

articles.t: Rockstar Games Confirms GTA 6 Brings Back Grand Theft Auto IV Feature
articles.chapeau: Rockstar Games has confirmed that GTA 6 is set to bring back a feature that debuted with Grand Theft Auto IV.
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games has confirmed that GTA 6 is set to bring back a feature that debuted in Grand Theft Auto IV , which many fans consider the best game in the series to date. Despite this, it is sometimes the forgotten game in the series because it’s been largely stranded on older, mostly inaccessible hardware. The trilogy is regularly re-released, and GTA 5 is both the latest game in the series and the second best-selling game of all time. GTA 4 exists somewhere in the middle of these, but it shouldn’t be forgotten. It’s not just the highest-rated game in the series, but it laid much of the groundwork for the modern Grand Theft Auto experience.
To this end, in Grand Theft Auto IV, Rockstar Games introduced the National Office of Security Enforcement, also known as NOOSE, a federal executive department meant to parody the United States Department of Homeland Security. And it plays a major role in the story of GTA 4 . More than that, though, it is the unit that is deployed at higher Wanted Levels.
In GTA 5 , NOOSE returns, but it doesn’t play the same role narratively as it does in the game’s predecessor. That said, NOOSE is also deployed at higher Wanted Levels. And we know it’s back in GTA 6 because it appears in the launch trailer of the game. More precisely, its Tactical Response Unit appears, teasing big chases with law enforcement.
This feature comes along with confirmation that Grand Theft Auto VI will have a new feature that no previous Rockstar Games game has had before , including not just GTA , but any Red Dead Redemption game.
This is on the official front. On the unofficial front, a new leak has revealed a collector’s map that is supposedly coming with every purchase of a standard copy of the game. This would be noteworthy because physical editions are disc-less, and it would be an exclusive item for the standard version. As you may know, the $100 version, which locks some content behind it, is digital only. As a result, those who purchase the $100 version can’t get the collector’s map without purchasing it second-hand or getting another $80 copy.
As for NOOSE, it’s not surprising to see it back. What remains to be seen is how differently it’s implemented. With GTA 6 , Rockstar Games has completely overhauled cops and other law enforcement , with a far more advanced and immersive system. When NOOSE shows up in GTA 5 or GTA 4 , it’s hardly immersive or realistic, so it will be interesting to see how Rockstar Games balances this.

articles.t: Activision Snubs Zelda, Calls Modern Warfare 4 and GTA 6 “the Two Biggest Games of the Year”
articles.chapeau: Activision's Chief Marketing Officer claims that Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and GTA 6 are 2026's biggest games, "no offense to Zelda".
articles.txt:
Much of the media coverage on the biggest games of this Fall season has been on Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 and Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake , but there's a third one that has no intention of getting overshadowed: Activision's Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 .
In an interview with The Game Business , Activision's Chief Marketing Officer Tyler Bahl argued that Call of Duty is still relevant enough to be a real contender for GTA 6, leaving Zelda sidelined .
No offense to Zelda, but I think these are the two biggest games of the year. In a lot of ways, more people coming into the dashboards, more people taking the dust off their Xbox or PlayStation and starting to play again and loading up that experience is going to be more eyeballs for us overall.
At the end of the day, what makes Call of Duty last the test of time is the community and the social experience. The idea of being able to play with your friends—when we look at our research and we say, ‘What is the most exciting thing about our games? Is it the combat or the gunplay?’—it’s actually, ‘My friends are there,’ or, ‘I’m able to spend time with my friends.’
I think we still stand on our own there, where being able to play with your friends on all different platforms, from Switch 2 this year, which is a new platform for us, all the way to PC and Xbox and PlayStation, still makes it a unique opportunity. It’s an exciting time for gaming. If more people are talking about games, if there’s more press around it, that’s going to be good for everybody. Not just us, but the entire industry.
There's little doubt that Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 will sell more than the Ocarina of Time remake: for starters, it's out on a lot more platforms, and it also marks the franchise's return to Nintendo consoles. Still, chances are the Ocarina of Time remake will be remembered much longer than Modern Warfare 4.
In the Game Business interview, Bahl also discussed Microsoft's decision to remove it from Game Pass at launch (unlike last year's Black Ops 7), claiming that customers will be less confused this time around:
For us, it was adding a little bit of confusion to the market, of how you can get Call of Duty. In a lot of ways, we really wanted to simplify that. Working with the Xbox team, though, they’ve been all in, and we’re really focused on how we get the message out. We actually had a 10% loyalty discount. We offered a blueprint with Xbox.
We understand, coming off of Game Pass, the perception there, and so I think we wanted to make sure that we’re still totally invested in Xbox and the community there, and making sure that we have an offering that is unique and exciting to that audience.

articles.t: GTA 6 to Feature "Hundreds" of Interior Spaces Players Can Exlpore; Story Closer to RDR2 Than GTA 5
articles.chapeau: In GTA 6, players will have "hundreds" of interiors that they're able to explore, such as offices, gas stations and more.
articles.txt:
Based on the gameplay footage, Grand Theft Auto 6 doesn’t just look stunning, but it has even managed to make a living world inside a game that’s not an MMORPG.
Not only will we see NPCs of all shapes and sizes, but Rockstar also used advanced AI to generate organic, random events
That’s not the only thing that’s technically impressive about GTA 6, as alongside the NPCs, the actual interiors of buildings will be places players can enter, and it’s not just a handful or a dozen, but “hundreds.”
In a behind-the-scenes feature for GTA 6 by Bloomberg , Rockstar Games’ Head of Publishing, Jennifer Kolbe, and development leads Aaron Garbut, Phil Hooker and Rob Nelson talked about the upcoming blockbuster.
Showing off the game, the developers did some side activities in-game, and in the process, confirmed that there are “hundreds” of these little interiors that players will be able to explore.
Nelson, using a controller, played as Jason, and called Lucia to ask if she was in the mood to hang out. When Lucia arrived, pressing a button made Jason kiss her, and they then went for a walk in the park. You can even hold hands while walking with the press of a button.
After going for a drive, the pair went to the gym, where the two can separately do activities such as Jason doing squats while Lucia was running on a treadmill. Once that was done, the duo went to a bank to see if it was worth robbing (Jason decided no since there were too many guards), and followed that up by entering a back office of what was said to be a gas station, where the pair disarmed the alarm, and stole some dough without alterting anyone, which prompted Rockstar to comment, “There’s so many of these little interiors — hundreds of them — that you can go and explore.”
Also of note, during the same feature, the game’s narrative was talked about as well. Surprisingly, instead of leaning into GTA 5’s crazy and crass-ness, Rockstar has instead chosen to go the route of Red Dead Redemption 2 in terms of storytelling.
Bloomberg’s Jason Schreier muses,”It seems like the story of Jason and Lucia is more inspired by Red Dead Redemption II than Grand Theft Auto V, which is welcome. The sour nihilism of the last Grand Theft Auto got tiring fast. I recently replayed the first hour of that 2013 game and immediately felt exhausted by the characters, who spend a lot of time insulting and yelling at each other. One thing is certain: this is a story about two people who actually enjoy spending time together.”

articles.t: GTA 6 : un vendeur propose enfin une édition physique Ultimate sur PS5, mais les disques cachent une énorme surprise
articles.chapeau: Un vendeur sinophone affiche une mystérieuse édition physique Ultimate de GTA 6 sur PS5, boîtier et disques Blu-ray à l’appui. Derrière ces images virales, un détail crucial pourrait tout changer pour les joueurs français.
articles.txt:
Un vendeur sinophone affiche une mystérieuse édition physique Ultimate de GTA 6 sur PS5, boîtier et disques Blu-ray à l’appui. Derrière ces images virales, un détail crucial pourrait tout changer pour les joueurs français.
Sur les réseaux, une photo affole en ce moment les fans de Grand Theft Auto VI : on y voit un vendeur sinophone proposer une édition physique de GTA 6 Ultimate Edition sur PS5 , avec vrai boîtier, visuels next gen et disque Blu-ray siglé PlayStation 5. Pour tous ceux qui rêvent encore d’un vrai disque dans leur console, l’espoir semble enfin revenir.
Dans un contexte où Rockstar Games mise surtout sur le tout-dématérialisé, ce coffret fait forcément saliver les collectionneurs. Sauf qu’en regardant de plus près ce mystérieux set, une énorme surprise apparaît : derrière cette « édition physique » très convaincante, il n’y a tout simplement aucun jeu.
L’image montre un pack baptisé « Commemorative Set Model », décliné en Standard Edition et Ultimate Edition pour PS5 . Chaque configuration comprend un boîtier au format jeu PS5, avec jaquette avant et arrière, logos officiels et même une carte cartonnée à l’intérieur censée rappeler un contenu numérique.
Surtout, les photos révèlent plusieurs disques Blu-ray marqués « GTA 6 PS5 », sérigraphiés comme de véritables galettes de lancement. Problème : ce set est présenté comme un simple objet de collection. Les Blu-ray sont purement décoratifs et ne contiennent aucun fichier jouable ; la carte incluse afficherait un code très probablement non activable. Autre détail troublant, l’artwork serait signé Lionheart , une agence de branding basée à Shanghai et Londres, sans qu’un accord officiel avec Take-Two Interactive ou Rockstar soit établi.
Concrètement, insérer ces disques dans une PS5 ne permettrait ni d’installer, ni de lancer GTA 6 : ils jouent le même rôle que les fausses boîtes de précommande que l’on voit parfois en rayon avant la sortie d’un jeu. Ce « Commemorative Set Model » s’adresse donc uniquement aux collectionneurs qui veulent un faux boîtier bien présenté sur leur étagère, pas à ceux qui cherchent une solution alternative au téléchargement.
Ce cas illustre surtout la situation actuelle de GTA 6 : à l’échelle mondiale, aucun Blu-ray officiel n’est annoncé sur PS5 ou Xbox Series X|S . Les versions dites « physiques » référencées chez les revendeurs se résument à une boîte contenant un code de téléchargement , sans disque. Même l’ Ultimate Edition , très mise en avant sur les stores, existe uniquement en numérique.
D’après les informations disponibles, GTA 6 est attendu le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, avec des précommandes déjà ouvertes dans certaines régions comme Hong Kong. En Chine continentale, aucune version n’est confirmée, ce qui explique pourquoi ce coffret en chinois semble viser surtout Hong Kong, Taïwan ou Singapour. Pour un joueur français, importer ce set n’a donc qu’un intérêt décoratif, avec en prime des frais de port et de douane, sans possibilité de jouer au titre.
Les fans en quête d’un objet officiel peuvent se tourner vers la The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection , aussi appelée Vice City Box : un énorme coffret à environ 400 $ soit à peu près 400 €, qui inclut une figurine Macca The Gator , des lunettes Oakley et divers goodies. Là encore, aucun disque ni même code du jeu n’est fourni. Pour l’instant, la seule façon de jouer à GTA 6 restera donc le téléchargement, et tout « disque GTA 6 PS5 » aperçu en ligne doit être considéré comme un simple produit d’exposition.
